title: Planner building blocks
caption: A parsed query goes through the planner steps, which ask the cost model for prices, and the cost model uses ANALYZE statistics from pg_statistic.

title: One query, nine steps
caption: Follow the numbers to see a query tree become a costed Plan that EXPLAIN prints.

badges.meaning: planner() hands the Query tree to standard_planner
subquery_planner flattens and simplifies the query
grouping_planner handles GROUP BY, ORDER BY, LIMIT
query_planner and make_one_rel size and path each table
costsize.c turns pg_statistic numbers into row and cost estimates
standard_join_search tries join orders (GEQO if many tables)
add_path drops Paths that are worse
create_plan turns the best Path into a Plan
EXPLAIN prints each node with estimated cost and rows

title: RelOptInfo and Path anatomy
caption: Each table or join keeps a RelOptInfo with a pathlist of Path structs, and each Path stores disabled_nodes, startup_cost and total_cost used to pick the winner.
